description: This file defines the 'Credit' model class for OpenCart, handling customer credit total calculations, confirming, and unconfirming transactions related to customer credits within the order process.

classes.name: Credit
classes.description: Model class responsible for handling customer credit total, confirmation, and unconfirmation processes in OpenCart.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Calculates and applies customer credit to the order total if available, and updates the totals array and the total amount.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Adds a transaction record for the customer's credit used in an order upon confirmation.

methods.name: unconfirm
methods.description: Removes transaction records associated with a specific order when the order is unconfirmed.
